title: [AUG-144] Transcribe MP4 and MOV video files via upload (extract audio track with bundled ffmpeg)
why_we_need_this: Users receive meeting recordings as video (Zoom/Teams/QuickTime exports are .mp4 or .mov) and today must convert them to audio with an external tool before August accepts them. The upload dropzone rejects video with "Unsupported file type", although the pipeline already converts any non-WAV input through the bundled ffmpeg (`ensureWav` in @server/src/services/whisper.ts). Accepting video directly removes a manual step, keeps the "no third-party upload" promise (everything stays local), and makes August usable for the most common way meeting recordings are shared.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] `.mp4` and `.mov` are accepted by the dropzone, the file picker `accept` attribute, the drag-and-drop validator and the formats hint in @client/src/components/FileUpload.tsx (ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS); case-insensitive (`.MP4`, `.MOV`).
- [ ] Uploading an .mp4 or .mov creates a session and produces a transcript identical in structure to an audio upload (same TranscriptView, export, Send to Praxis).
- [ ] Audio extraction uses the bundled ffmpeg resolved by config.ts (FFMPEG_PATH / whisper/bin / PATH), with video stream discarded (`-vn`) and output 16 kHz mono WAV, reusing `ensureWav` and its fresh-derivative cache; no new npm dependency.
- [ ] A video without an audio stream (or with a corrupt container) fails the session with a clear user-facing error ("The video has no audio track" / "Could not read video file") instead of a raw ffmpeg stderr dump; the session enters the existing failed state with "Transcribe again" available.
- [ ] `getAudioDuration()` (ffprobe) returns the correct duration for .mp4/.mov so the Chronometer Ring estimate is accurate.
- [ ] Audio boost and retranscribe (POST /api/sessions/:id/retranscribe) work on a video-sourced session, operating on the extracted WAV.
- [ ] Non-ASCII file names and paths work on Windows (toSafePath 8.3 short paths) and macOS (passthrough); verified with a Cyrillic-named .mov on at least one platform and reasoned for the other.
- [ ] Server-side upload validation (if any extension/mime check is added) mirrors the client list; existing audio formats keep working.
- [ ] Unit tests cover: extension acceptance list, ensureWav branch for video containers (mocked ffmpeg), no-audio-stream error mapping.
- [ ] project-context/transcription/README.md documents supported input formats and the video-to-WAV extraction rule.
important_constraints:
- Both platforms: ffmpeg binary name differs (`ffmpeg.exe` vs `ffmpeg`); use `config.ffmpegPath`, never a hardcoded name. Guard any platform branch with `process.platform`.
- Keep the existing rule: a failed transcription never deletes or modifies the session's source files. The original video stays in the session folder; the extracted WAV is a derivative like the existing `-boosted.wav`. If storage of large videos becomes a concern, raise it as a follow-up task, do not silently delete.
- Post-recording transcription stays local whisper only; do not route video through Groq.
- multer limit is already 2 GB (@server/src/routes/sessions.ts); do not lower it. Check that the 2 GB ceiling is enough for a ~1 h 1080p recording and note the result in the card.
- Do not add ffmpeg-static or any npm media package (decision: ffmpeg is a pinned download in whisper/bin/).
- Follow the brutalist UI rules (0 border-radius) if the formats hint or error message styling changes.

## 2 GB check (2026-10-27, bitrate estimate, not measured on a real 1 h file)
- Zoom/Teams 1080p export (~1–2 Mbps): ~0.5–0.9 GB/h — fits under 2 GB.
- QuickTime 1080p H.264 screen recording (~10–20 Mbps): ~4.5–9 GB/h — exceeds 2 GB; ~1 h QuickTime recordings will be rejected by multer. Possible follow-up: raise limit or offer local-path import (not done here).

## ✅ Итог (2026-10-28)
**Что сделано:**
- Дропзона, file picker и подсказка форматов принимают `.mp4`/`.mov` без учёта регистра; текст «audio or video file».
- Для видео `ensureWav` сначала проверяет аудиодорожку через ffprobe, затем извлекает её bundled ffmpeg в 16 kHz mono WAV (`-vn -sn -dn`, таймаут 600 с); исходное видео остаётся в папке сессии.
- Видео без звука / битый контейнер → сессия failed с «The video has no audio track…» / «Could not read video file…», stderr только в лог.
- Boost для single-track работает по извлечённому WAV; расширение исходника приводится к нижнему регистру (`audio.mov`).
**Как:** список форматов и классификация ffprobe вынесены в чистый модуль `mediaFormats.ts` (тестируемо, клиентский список сверяется тестом). Серверную проверку расширений сознательно не добавили — браузерные записи (.webm/.ogg/.mp4) идут через тот же endpoint. ffmpeg-static/npm-пакеты отвергнуты по решению AUG-115.
**Файлы:** @server/src/services/mediaFormats.ts, @server/src/services/whisper.ts, @server/src/routes/sessions.ts, @client/src/components/FileUpload.tsx, @server/src/services/mediaFormats.test.ts, @server/src/services/whisper.video.test.ts, @project-context/transcription/README.md
**PR / коммиты:** без PR; влито в `master` коммитом 89bfcee (вместе с AUG-145..149), запушено в origin/master.
**Грабли:** `boostAudio` падал на кириллических путях Windows — `toSafePath` для ещё не существующего выходного файла возвращал искажённое 8.3-имя, rename падал (баг существовал и для аудио). Теперь через `toSafePath` идёт только существующий вход; ffmpeg сам пишет не-ASCII пути. Проверено реальным ffmpeg на `Встреча/Запись встречи.mov`; в bundled ffmpeg нет libx264 (для тестовых видео — `mpeg4`).
**Хвосты:** macOS не прогонялся вживую (passthrough путей, обосновано). Лимит 2 GB не покрывает часовые QuickTime-записи — сообщение вынесено в AUG-145; извлечение вне запроса — AUG-147; проверка дорожки в браузере — AUG-146.
